Pro feature

Chad builds you a structured plan around your macro target — real foods, exact portions, accurate numbers from the USDA food database. Logging what you actually ate? Calorie Tracker · Rate My Kitchen.

2,200 cal cut — 3 meals/day

Target 2,200 cal · 180g protein / 220g carbs / 70g fat per day (your daily Calorie Tracker targets, too)

Edit
PDF
Ask Chad

Three weeks in and you're still arguing instead of eating right. This plan is dead simple: high protein to protect muscle while you drop fat, whole foods you can't screw up. Weigh every portion on a food scale and log it in the Calorie Tracker — no eyeballing, no 'I think that's about a cup.' Hit these numbers every single day and the scale moves. Don't, and you'll be right back here making excuses.
